metadata.question: Does evapotranspiration in Pakistan increase in August 2018 compared to January 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS ET product (MOD16A2.006) or ERA5 evapotranspiration - Two time periods: January 2018 and August 2018 - Location: Pakistan boundary 2. Masking strategy: - ET data typically doesn't need cloud masking - Focus on valid ET values 3. Logic: - Calculate mean ET for both months - Compare: if August > January, answer A (Yes) - Handle cases: C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculation) - This is comparing absolute values, so valid zero is possible (A/B answer) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Pakistan boundary const pakistan = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Pakistan')) .geometry(); // Time periods const jan2018Start = '2018-01-01'; const jan2018End = '2018-01-31'; const aug2018Start = '2018-08-01'; const aug2018End = '2018-08-31'; // Load MODIS ET data (8-day product, unit: kg/m²/8day) const etCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD16A2'); // Get January 2018 data const janCol = etCollection .filterDate(jan2018Start, jan2018End) .filterBounds(pakistan) .select('ET'); // Get August 2018 data const augCol = etCollection .filterDate(aug2018Start, aug2018End) .filterBounds(pakistan) .select('ET'); // Check collection sizes const janSize = janCol.size().getInfo(); const augSize = augCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January 2018 images: ${janSize}`); console.log(`August 2018 images: ${augSize}`); if (janSize === 0 || augSize === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Calculate mean ET for each period const janET = janCol.mean(); const augET = augCol.mean(); // Reduce to get mean values over Pakistan const janStats = janET.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: pakistan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const augStats = augET.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: pakistan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const janMean = janStats.ET_mean; const janCount = janStats.ET_count; const augMean = augStats.ET_mean; const augCount = augStats.ET_count; console.log(`January 2018 - Mean ET: ${janMean}, Valid pixels: ${janCount}`); console.log(`August 2018 - Mean ET: ${augMean}, Valid pixels: ${augCount}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (janCount === 0 || augCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for invalid calculations if (janMean === null || janMean === undefined || isNaN(janMean) || augMean === null || augMean === undefined || isNaN(augMean)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare and determine answer console.log(`Change: ${((augMean - janMean) / janMean * 100).toFixed(2)}%`); if (augMean > janMean) { console.log('August ET is higher than January ET.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('August ET is not higher than January ET.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
